Keys types text into a g3d-termd session, then presses Enter (--no-enter
skips it). The text is typed literally: key names like "Escape" are typed as
words; use "agent key" to press special keys.

This is a low-level command for driving arbitrary sessions, and takes a
session name (agent "helper"'s session is "agent-helper"). It does no dialog
checks: to message an agent, use "agent send".

name@host addresses a managed agent instead of a session, on any host
(including this one). Buses don't serve keys to other hosts unless
configured to.

Usage:
  agent keys <session | name@host> <text> [flags]

Examples:
  agent keys my-session "ls -la"
  agent keys my-session "echo hello" --no-enter
  agent keys builder@hub "y" --no-enter

Flags:
  -h, --help       help for keys
      --no-enter   Don't send Enter after text

Global Flags:
      --backend string          Backend for spawn or adopt: claude, aider, agy, or shell (spawn requires it or --backend-config; adopt auto-detects)
      --backend-config string   JSON file defining a custom backend (or app settings); pass it again to status/wait/watch for agents spawned with it
  -q, --quiet                   Don't print hints (results and errors still print)
      --termd-ns string         g3d-termd namespace (default: agents; never default or wall)
